data_fields.name: tiled_repeat_draws_per_sprite
data_fields.donor_constant: xrepeat x yrepeat from the draw method (per sprite)

best_idea: Freeze the scene into one base layer while a menu is open (pause = one queued screen sprite kept across frames), and keep draw order as explicit (z, sortid, insertion) keys with a z-band filter so a caller can draw one depth band at a time.
decision_why: Keep the frozen base layer and the z-band draw; drop the in-place selection sort (about n^2/4 compares, derived not timed) and the silent drop at the cap; use a stable sort and counted drops.
acceptance: Opening the pause menu during a three-attacker fight shows the same frozen frame with no sprite redrawn beneath it, and a client test asserts that equal z and sortid keep insertion order and that a full queue reports a drop count.
